abilities.name: Houndblade Charge
abilities.text: Once per turn, add +1 Grit to the first battle you start.

abilities.name: Loyal Guard
abilities.text: Descriptive only. Kira is the roster's guardian striker; ally-damage transfer needs an explicit shared-reaction window before it can become a live rule.

abilities.name: Ash-Scent Tracker
abilities.text: Descriptive only. Kira tracks non-blue threats after they are revealed.

abilities.name: Heroic Bite
abilities.text: After you defeat an enemy with difficulty 7 or higher, mark it as a hard-won trophy in the encounter record. Weakness: Ash-Scent Tracker cannot inspect blue Anomalies.
